Scope: Native reusable effect-engine consolidation in eighteen production repositories; compatibility includes all twenty demo modules. Collection hosts and all presentation units are included. Full FR-010 and Second Reality part-renderer extraction is excluded.

SourceInventory.Classification: Remaining loops prepare assets, resolve input/menu state, dispatch shared-controller events, compose layers or release resources. No additional active local scrolling, trajectory, deformation, mesh or shader engine was found.

FontsAndModes.Scope: Catalog bitmap fonts with independent mixed-size faces and twelve shared glyph modes; specialized transport fidelity has separate checks.

GPURegression.SourceFailure: Reproduced nil Update error with unavailable borrowed artwork before the fix; same Update now reports the error without advancing feedback history or phase callbacks.

Limits: Deterministic checkpoints do not prove every intermediate frame or equivalence with Atari hardware.
Source-to-DCK tiny sampling differences and intentional visual changes remain visible in EFFECT_MAP.md.
Pixel presentation and process snapshots do not establish actual memory peaks or battery use.
The graphical editor is a separate application task; not every Go callback is represented in the saved-project schema.
